children: Mumbai, Nov. 4 -- Bollywood actor Kartik Aaryan and filmmaker Kabir Khan have come together with Ananya Birla's Birla Studios for a heart-tugging, inspiring film titled 'Ladaku'.
Birla Studios, on Wednesday, announced the worldwide theatrical release date of 'Ladaku' as June 18, 2027.

The film is produced by Birla Studios and Kabir Khan Entertainment, further marking the debut of Kartik Aaryan as a producer with Dopamine Studios. Ladaku narrates an extraordinary real-life story of ambition, grit and hope, the makers said.
The announcement adds another project to the actor's slate of films.
Kartik Aaryan is currently with his upcoming film 'Captain India'.
Directed by Shimit Amin, best known for his work in Shah Rukh Khan's 'Chak De! India', the film is produced by T-Series' Bhushan Kumar and Baweja Studios alongside Dopamine Studios.
SB Films will be handling the production.
In another feather in his cap, Kartik Aaryan received the National Award for Best Actor for 'Chandu Champion'.
